program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cover (at g (- h 1) (- w 1)))
                  (top-h (let loop
                              ((r 0))
                              (if (or (>= r h) (= (at g r 0) cover)) r (loop (+ r 1)))))
                  (prefix (let loop
                               ((c 0) (acc (list)))
                               (if (or (>= c w) (= (at g 0 c) cover))
                                   acc
                                   (loop (+ c 1) (append acc (list (at g 0 c)))))))
                  (n (length prefix))
                  (col-period (find-first (lambda (p)
                                            (for/and ((i (range 0 n)))
                                                     (= (nth prefix i)
                                                        (nth prefix (modulo i p)))))
                                          (range 1 (+ n 1))))
                  (row-period (find-first (lambda (p)
                                            (for/and ((r (range 0 top-h)))
                                                     (for/and ((c (range 0 col-period)))
                                                              (= (at g r c)
                                                                 (at g (modulo r p) c)))))
                                          (range 1 (+ top-h 1)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (at g (modulo r row-period) (modulo (+ c 1) col-period)))))))
